scripts.still: bun src/build.ts && slopcamera html still --input out/16x9/scene.json --at 2.5,7,11,13.5,18,22.5,26,30,35 --output out/16x9/stills
scripts.still:portrait: bun src/build.ts --aspect 9:16 && slopcamera html still --input out/9x16/scene.json --at 2.5,7,11,13.5,18,22.5,26,30,35 --output out/9x16/stills
scripts.render: bun src/build.ts && slopcamera html render --input out/16x9/scene.json --json > out/16x9/export.json
scripts.render:portrait: bun src/build.ts --aspect 9:16 && slopcamera html render --input out/9x16/scene.json --json > out/9x16/export.json
scripts.deliver: slopcamera html deliver out/16x9/export.json --basename clankdar-launch --poster-at 18 --social-at 18 --cuts 1:1 --beats out/16x9/beats.json --per-beat-clips --output out/deliver
scripts.deliver:portrait: slopcamera html deliver out/9x16/export.json --basename clankdar-launch-vertical --poster-at 18 --social-at 18 --beats out/9x16/beats.json --per-beat-clips --output out/deliver-vertical
